# Configured reports synthetic projection

This family is default-off (`reports`). The root's staff exact-None witness used only
`reports:read` at `reports:*` with GET `/api/reports`: reader and Admin returned HTTP
200, count one, matching transient population. Recorded witness objects were removed
and checked absent. No report was created or sent by this implementation lane.
This positive control does not prove universal visibility or strict minimality.

`reports.json` is a synthetic minimized bare-array schema fixture, not a live export.
Its disabled object demonstrates configured count, not execution, delivery or activity.
Tests add synthetic private sentinels at the process edge and check that none survive.
IDs are validated only transiently; no object detail is retained. The unchanged global
structural credential guard still rejects known credential fields, including nested ones.

The count-only `reports_inventory` compose projection is appended offline using
`python bin/make_compose_fixture.py --synthetic-reports`, preserving every pre-existing
value and formatting. Its illustrative counts are not measurements. The view has
only stack and count rows, no product metric. Source requires exact HTTP 200, a complete
bare array, bounded schema and valid IDs; wrapper/paging/partial/unreadable bodies are
unknown, not zero. Fresh inventory drives collection and composition. Last-good views
are withheld from replacement when input is unavailable, with advancing input age.
